remarks: Welcome to this stunning luxury estate in the desirable Rancho El Dorado Estates community, featuring beautiful city lights and mountain views. The grand entry showcases soaring ceilings and elegant finishes, leading to a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, a spacious sit-in island, and a custom built-in refrigerator. A generously sized downstairs bedroom and full bathroom offer convenience and flexibility for guests or multigenerational living. Upstairs, a large skylight fills the home with natural light, while the expansive primary suite features vaulted ceilings, a private retreat, and a relaxing jetted tub.
